bottleneck.summary: Small source Eli Tc gain12.871 versus12.235K; all ten lambda contrasts positive but q3x3x5 versus4^3. Coarse/fine phase-energy preference flips at sub-meV fine scale; assess as near-degenerate phase response, not global ground state. Evaluated risks define a falsifiable bounded hypothesis, not an established bulk ground state or experimental coherence proof.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source nearambient fullstress/pressure and coarse-relaxed geometry, positive raw-Gamma optical compression beyond printing bounds, and no negative printed finite-path values support preliminary local feasibility only within the declared source approximation. WholeBZ/global hull/synthesis remain unknown.
